Tabletop banners: Ultra-portable, space-saving design

Make the most of table space at restaurants, offices, pop-up stores, and other venues by custom printing tabletop banners. Compact yet big on impact, our tabletop banner is the little brother of our full-sized retractable one. Lightweight but durable, this custom table banner is easy to set up and store. 

 

The compact design is ideal for tiny tradeshow booths and for any location where space may be limited. The high-resolution printing allows you to prominently display your logo or your call to action, capturing the attention of your customers.  

 

These tabletop displays are great to display on their own, but you can also use them to complement your other marketing tools

 

Ready to Display at Any Given Time

Measuring 11.5" x 16", this custom table banner comes with a lightweight aluminum base and graphics.  

 

The graphics are printed on a water and wrinkle-resistant 9 mil. poly film with a gray back. To maximize the full-color print, we recommend having your artwork set to 150 dpi and in CMYK color mode.  

 

When we ship this banner to you, it will come in a box and fully assembled, so you can set it up on your booth table in just a matter of minutes. Promote to a bigger audience by bulk printing tabletop banners. Order as many as 50 pieces. 

 

Tabletop Banner FAQs 

Our tabletop banners are available only in 11.5" x 16". This is the perfect size for displaying on tabletops and other small spaces. If you need larger sizes, you can check out our other custom banners in a variety of sizes.  

We currently do not offer front and back printing for tabletop banners.

There’s no minimum order required for tabletop banners. You can order as few as one (1) piece and as many as 50 pieces.
